caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair positioned centrally against a plain, light beige background with minor speckling. The chair features a rectangular backrest and seat made from a brown, textured material, likely leather, which is attached to the frame with closely placed, round brass-colored rivets or tacks along the edges. The frame of the chair is made up of four sturdy wooden legs with visible grain, two straight armrests, and a decorative horizontal support between the front legs that displays three oval medallion shapes in its design. The overall color palette consists of varying shades of brown for the chair, with the background remaining an uncolored, off-white tone. There is a small, red signature or mark near the bottom right of the composition.
title: Arm Chair
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
